article.title: 做好
article.part: Modificación y complementos — 修飾與補語

claims.summary: The construction '做好' (zuò hǎo) indicates that an action has been completed with a satisfactory or finished result.
In '做好', '做' expresses the action and '好' functions as a resultative complement, signaling the state achieved after performing the action.
Examples such as '飯做好了' (the food is ready) and '你做好準備了嗎？' (Are you prepared?) illustrate the usage of '做好' to denote completion or readiness.
The article distinguishes '做好' from '做得好', clarifying that '做好' focuses on the completion of an action, while '做得好' evaluates the quality of the action.
